extracted.intended_audience: general public and researchers seeking an encyclopedic summary of PG&E's incidents, legal actions, and controversies
extracted.subtask_description: An encyclopedic article summarizing major incidents, investigations, fines, lawsuits, settlements, and criticisms involving Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E) across multiple years. Presents factual narrative, references, and sources for readers wanting an overview of the company's controversies and regulatory history.
